scope: Theorem 4.8 (Uniform sparse-pin estimate) of the manuscript “Bloch's Law for Finite-Range Heisenberg Ferromagnets in Three Dimensions” (preprints/Blochs-Law-for-Finite-Range-Heisenberg-Ferromagnets-in-Three-Dimensions-October-5-2026/bloch-law-heisenberg.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4884bc0984dfd0f6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is β1 < ∞, independent of the cube and pins, such that for every β ≥ β1, every allowed pin set E, and every nonempty sparse set T at one deterministic time, disjoint from E, PE(T ⊆ BE) ≤ β−9|T|/10 . (4.15) Consequently (4.6) and (4.9) hold under every allowed pin law, with no induction hypothesis.
